title: Chapter 717
text:
Bloodshed Land and Section Zero had been competing for ten years, and both parties were extremely familiar with each other. This was another battle, and both parties were well prepared.

Section Zero's troops did not waste any time and quickly launched an attack on the last base station in the Kant Star System.

The battlefront included all the enemy strongholds, and more than ten planets were lit up in flames.

The Black Star Corps' fleet cooperated with the other members to attack the various strongholds. Currently, the players were not of much use in galactic warfare, so Han Xiao planned to use the players as the vanguard of the ground battle. They would be at the most intense frontline, and while it was filled with danger, they would also be at the frontline. They would be able to charge at the enemy's defense line without fear of death.

As for Han Xiao himself, he would be at the core of the main battlefield and follow the rest of the troops to attack the enemy's core hyperdrive base station.

His side had the absolute advantage in terms of military strength, and he did not need to charge in alone this time. He only needed to sit on the Star Diamond Grade flagship, SS Eternity, and watch as his fleet charged at the enemy's defense line and slowly advanced.

In the command room of SS Eternity, the walls of the spaceship were like transparent crystals. It was as though they were standing on an open-air platform, and they could clearly observe the battlefield outside from all angles.

In the command room, there was a colorful holographic projection of the battlefield, and the commanders and strategists were monitoring the changes on the battlefield.

Han Xiao stood by the side and observed.

He was not the commander this time, but as the strongest high-level combatant on his side, he was also a member of the upper echelons. He sat in the command room and was ready to attack at any time.

The commander and the others were analyzing the battlefield, and Han Xiao was listening.

"… The enemy has transferred a portion of the fleets from the other strongholds back to defend the base station. Their counterattack is very strong, and we will need a long time to break through the enemy's defense line and satellite defense base.

However, there is also good news. As many of the enemy's troops have gathered to defend the base station, the defense of the stronghold itself has decreased, and our troops attacking the other strongholds are gaining an advantage. "

Han Xiao nodded. The hyperdrive base station was connected to all the strongholds, and it was like a heart that transported blood to the various organs. Most importantly, the moment it was lost, the entire base station would be gone.

As they had the advantage in terms of military strength, the majority of the troops would focus on attacking the base station while the other troops would pressure the other strongholds. This way, in order to defend the hyperdrive base station, the enemy would have no choice but to transfer troops from the other strongholds.

Section Zero's objective was actually to destroy the fleets of those planetary strongholds. That was because the moment the hyperdrive base station was lost, the fleets of the various enemy strongholds would decisively retreat to preserve their strength.

Therefore, although it looked like a general attack on the main battlefield, it was actually to delay the enemy so that the other troops could kill more enemies and expand the battle results. The more troops there were, the more willful they were.

Han Xiao's gaze swept across the battlefield, observing Hardaway's whereabouts. His job today was to repel Hardaway.

Not seeing Hardaway fighting, Han Xiao rubbed his chin. "Is he not going to fight? Have you found any traces of him on the other battlefields?"

Perhaps Hardaway would avoid him and use the advantage of the hyperdrive base station's mobility to support the other strongholds through the wormhole. The other troops did not have any high-level combatants who could stop him.

However, Han Xiao was not worried. If Hardaway dared to avoid him, it would mean that no one in the enemy base could restrain him. He could then push the line and force Hardaway to defend the crystal.

"The other teams didn't find any traces of him." The commander shook his head. "He's still in the base station. As long as he doesn't come out, you don't have to do anything. They're the ones who are anxious."

Han Xiao nodded and opened the player forums to pass the time.

At this time, the players were all doing their own battle missions. A large number of posts on the forums were screenshots of the various battlefields, showing the different enemies, bosses, and spoils of war.

There were also some players who posted videos and livestreams. For example, the players of the various clubs took the initiative to broadcast the scenes of professional players teaming up to attract fans.

Participating in such a huge battle made them feel very excited. Fighting on the frontlines was not easy, and it was only interesting when there was a challenge. Han Xiao roughly scanned the forums, and most of the players were satisfied with this battle.

Compared to the players of the other Star Fields who were still figuring out the main storyline, the players of the Black Star Corps had already started to absorb the nutrients of the main storyline.

After browsing the forums for a while, the commander's urgent call made Han Xiao come back to his senses.

"Hardaway has appeared!"

Han Xiao's eyes lit up. He closed the forums and looked at the battlefield. He saw Hardaway appear in the attacking fleet of the Black Star Corps, attacking battleships one after another. Lagi went to intercept him, and the two of them had already started to fight.

"Your Excellency Black Star, please repel him," the commander said solemnly.

…

In the interstellar battlefield where ion cannons crisscrossed, Lagi and Hardaway were fighting. The staff in his hand flickered, and dazzling magic Radiance smashed onto Hardaway's body like a waterfall, turning into fragments of light like broken jade.

Hardaway was a close-combat main tank, and Lagi was a long-range cannon. The two of them were clearly kiting each other.

The battlefield kept changing, and the violent energy waves from the battle between the two of them were as dazzling as stars in the detection radar. The battleships nearby were all affected.

The two of them moved from one corner of the battlefield to another. It was only a short distance in the universe. Hardaway grabbed the opportunity and crashed into a Section Zero battleship with Lagi. The two of them fell into the cabin of the battleship, then quickly got up and faced each other.

An ear-piercing alarm sounded inside the battleship, and all kinds of defense measures were activated. All kinds of small floating guards, mobile cannons, and mechanical guards rushed over from various passages. The guards of the fleet also rushed over.

Dense footsteps and mechanical sounds came from the passage behind Hardaway. He did not turn around and punched behind him.

The huge force compressed the air in the cabin, and a powerful shockwave swept out like a hurricane. The cabin behind him was torn apart, and the guards who rushed over were almost all wiped out.

Hardaway retracted his hand, looked at Lagi, and praised, "As expected of the deputy commander of the Black Star Corps. Your magic makes me feel very dangerous. Among all the mages I have seen, your strength can be ranked in the top five."

"Sigh, if I had known, I would have chosen to be a Psychic back then. What's the use of magic? It can't kill you, and learning it is so tiring."

Lagi sighed and put down his staff.

Seeing that Lagi had no intention of attacking, Hardaway asked with confusion, "Are you going to admit defeat?"

Lagi shook his head. "I can't kill you, and you can't kill me. Anyway, Black Star will be here soon. Let's just go through the motions and save some energy."

Hardaway had a strange expression. You are the one who wants to slack off!

At this time, Han Xiao flew in through the hole in the battleship. When he saw the two of them getting along peacefully, he was stunned.

Without waiting for him to speak, Lagi spoke first.

"I'll leave this place to you."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lagi used a teleportation spell to teleport himself out and disappeared.

Han Xiao was helpless against Lagi's lazy attitude and turned to look at Hardaway.

"It's you again. Why did you have to go to Bloodshed Land to create trouble for me? If you like being beaten up by me so much, you might as well let me catch you and beat you up three times a day."

As soon as he saw Han Xiao, Hardaway's fighting spirit was ignited, and he pounced forward. "Only when I'm your enemy will you have killing intent toward me. Only such a battle is worth it!"

Han Xiao had already activated his Machinery Apostilization and stacked almost a thousand attributes. He dodged Hardaway's attack, grabbed his arm, and threw him out, smashing a new hole in the battleship.

Psionic energy flowed into his body through the Mechanical Force transmitted through the void. Han Xiao raised his hand and shot out a Psionic Impact, blasting Hardaway a little further away. Only then did he summon the Mech Legion.

A cold voice sounded from Han Xiao's mechanical helmet.

"Legion Combat System, Sparta, awaiting orders!"

This was the artificial intelligence that belonged to the Mech Legion. Han Xiao named it Sparta. This name sounded like it knew how to fight.

Han Xiao gave the order, and the Mech Legion cooperated under Sparta's control. The black mass of mechanical soldiers chased after Hardaway.

After fighting with him so many times, Han Xiao knew Hardaway's abilities like the back of his hand. As it was difficult to kill this troublemaker, the Mech Legion focused on control.

Hardaway and the Mech Legion fought intensely. Han Xiao casually fired from the side, occasionally destroying the approaching enemy ships. He also entered Hardaway's voice channel to harass him.

"Stop fighting. You can't win anyway."

"When are you planning to escape this time? I'll leave you a path in advance."

"Let's negotiate. You stand still and let me fire a few shots to vent my anger. Next time, I'll fight you in close combat. How about that?"

"Heh, how much did Bloodshed Land pay you? I'll double it. Be my subordinate."

Hardaway's face turned darker and darker. He could not help but roar, "Shut up! Focus on hitting me! "

He liked to use strong enemies to squeeze out his potential. He felt that only a thrilling battle with all his might could yield results. The moment he was distracted by Han Xiao, he immediately felt annoyed.

Han Xiao was about to say something when Joad's serious voice suddenly sounded in the communication channel. Both he and Hardaway heard it.

"Hardaway, use the weapon I gave you immediately."

Weapon?

The enemy might have prepared some special means for me … Han Xiao immediately became alert. The Mech Legion intensified their attacks. At the same time, he stared at Hardaway's every move.

However, Hardaway acted as if he did not hear anything. He focused on fighting the Mech Legion.

"Did you hear that!" Joad said angrily. "Are you going to disobey my orders?"

Hadavy turned a deaf ear to him.

Joad's tone suddenly turned cold. "I knew you wouldn't listen."

Hadavy suddenly felt that something was wrong. The 'special weapon' on him suddenly reacted. It was a Secret Message Bead, and it suddenly unlocked on its own. A pale white ball of light that was between reality and illusion flew out. It looked like it existed in the form of energy, and it was only the size of a palm. It floated beside Hadavy.

"What's this?"

Han Xiao and Hardaway were both stunned.

Without waiting for the two of them to think, the white ball of light suddenly disappeared and teleported to Han Xiao's shoulder. Han Xiao had already been alert and reacted immediately.

Void Travel!

The surrounding space seemed to have frozen. Han Xiao got rid of the white ball of light and quickly retreated. This thing looked very strange, so it was best to stay as far away as possible.

The next moment, the white ball of light turned into a stream of light and shot over. It could actually move in the Void Dimension!

Han Xiao was shocked. He kept dodging, but the white ball of light chased after him.

Han Xiao hurriedly deactivated Void Travel and directly used a short-range hyperdrive to leave the battlefield. However, the white ball of light teleported in front of him again like a directional skill. It was going to hit him no matter what.

This thing can't be dodged … Han Xiao's eyes narrowed. He fired a cannon, but the white ball of light was like an illusion. The cannon went right through it.

Since there was no way to dodge, Han Xiao simply put up multiple layers of psionic shields. The Mountain Ape mechanical suit's arm turned into an armored shield and faced it in the opposite direction.

However, the layers of defense could not touch the white ball of light at all. The ball of light went right through, hit Han Xiao's body, and then disappeared.

Han Xiao touched his body. He did not seem to be injured.

"What is this … Urgh!"

A sharp pain suddenly exploded in his brain. A combat notification popped up on the interface.

You have been hit by Sisko's [Psychic — Parasitic Toxin]. You have received 14,860 mental damage!

You have entered [Split Personality] state. Duration unknown.

You have entered [Soul Poison] state. Duration unknown.

You have entered [Sensory Misdirection] state. Duration unknown.

You have entered [Parasitic Mind] state. Duration unknown.

You have entered [Hallucination] state. Duration unknown.

Han Xiao clenched his teeth and stared at the notification on the interface.

What shocked him the most was the attacker.

Sisko.

The only Beyond Grade A in the Shattered Star Ring that he had never fought before!

Psychic!
